title: Improving perinatal oral health care access
html: Oral health during the perinatal period is correlated to health of mother and child. In 2022, North Carolina (NC) legislators revised Medicaid for Pregnant Women (MPW) policies to expand oral health care coverage up to 12 months postpartum. However, usage of benefits remains low across the state. The authors sought to address low usage by means of identifying consumer-centered system-level strategies.
